Regarding the statute from the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) mentioned in the text: The employer sanctions provision makes it unlawful for employers to knowingly hire, recruit, or refer for a fee individuals who are not authorized to work in the United States. Legal implications of violating this provision include substantial civil fines and potential criminal penalties, depending on the nature and frequency of the violations. This provision is designed to deter the employment of unauthorized aliens and enforce immigration laws within the workplace.
